citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera)
WHERE c.mode = 'crowd'
  AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z'
  AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH c.camera_location AS camera_location,
     sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS weighted_sum,
     sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples
RETURN camera_location,
       CASE WHEN total_samples > 0 THEN weighted_sum / total_samples ELSE null END AS avg_head_count
ORDER BY camera_location
